meta.name: refactor
meta.description: Intelligent refactor command. Triggers: refactor, refactoring, cleanup, restructure, extract, simplify, modernize.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 重构代码结构，消除坏味道，提升可维护性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果代码变得难以维护，需要系统性地改善结构
copy.tagline_en: Restructure code, eliminate bad smells, and improve maintainability
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your codebase has become hard to maintain and needs systematic structural improvement

howto.what: 收到重构类请求后，Claude 不会直接改代码，而是先弄清目标、受影响的文件和测试情况，再制定分步计划；每改一步就运行测试，最后做回归检查并汇报改动清单。
howto.when: 当你输入 /refactor 命令，或要求重构、清理、简化代码时接管；指令含糊时（如只说“改进”）会先追问目标和范围。

say.text: 清理 src/services 里重复代码，保持对外行为完全一致
say.note: “清理”属开放式指令，它会先确认具体要做什么。

say.text: 重构所有调用旧版 API 的地方，改用新的 auth 模块写法
say.note: 它会先查找全部引用，再统一替换并逐步验证。

howto.what_en: Claude will not edit code right away. It first confirms intent, maps affected files and dependencies, checks test coverage, and creates a plan. Each step runs tests; it finishes with a full regression check and a change summary.
howto.when_en: Activates when you run /refactor or ask to refactor, clean up, or simplify code; if the request is vague (e.g., just "improve this"), it asks clarifying questions first.

say_en.text: Refactor src/auth/handler.ts: extract validation logic into its own module.
say_en.note: It checks scope and tests, then refactors incrementally.

say_en.text: Clean up duplicated code in src/services while keeping behavior unchanged.
say_en.note: Cleanup is vague, so Claude confirms the goal first.

say_en.text: Refactor all callers of the old API to use the new auth module style.
say_en.note: It finds all references first, replaces them step by step.
